title: Concept: Dormant-account flag in a response
description: A dormant-account flag in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: A dormant flag marks an account nobody is watching, which makes it the preferred target for account takeover and for using the customer as a money mule.
applicability: Deployments that render a dormant-account flag into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: A dormant flag marks an account nobody is watching, which makes it the preferred target for account takeover and for using the customer as a money mule.
